title: TY Hilton 2018 Panini Unparalleled High Flyers HF-TH Indianapolis Colts NFL
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This sports trading card features TY Hilton from the 2018 Panini Unparalleled set. The card showcases Hilton in action as a High Flyer, making it a must-have for any Indianapolis Colts fan or football card collector. The card is standard size and was manufactured in the United States by Panini for the National Football League (NFL). It is an original card from the 2018 season and is not autographed.

The card is part of the Modern (1981-Now) era and is an original/reprint. It is a great addition to any sports memorabilia collection and is perfect for display or trading. Get your hands on this card today and add it to your collection!
